what: When the daemon panics while serving a build, the blaze client exits 101 and prints nothing (hello6: the panic was only in b2-home-6/v2/serve.log). Print the daemon's panic message and where (or the path of serve.log with its last lines) before exiting, as an error naming the request.
why: Part 3 of 01268. no-fallback: a failure must stop with an error naming what and where, not a bare exit code.
